districtFact: Aurora Public Schools serves families in Aurora and the east metro Denver area. Its conventional calendar separates grades 1–12 and preschool/kindergarten start dates, preschool and grades K–12 last days, professional release days, educator workdays, parent conference exchange days, and English/Spanish calendar resources.

about.title: About the Aurora Public Schools Calendar
about.content: APS publishes a conventional district calendar with separate timing for grades 1–12 and preschool/kindergarten in 2026–27. That distinction matters for families with children in different grade bands because the first and last day are not identical across the district.

about.title: Which Calendar This Page Covers
about.content: This page summarizes the APS conventional district calendar. Families should also check their school for transportation, testing, graduation, school-specific events, child care availability, and alternative schedule details.

planningTips.title: APS Calendar Notes
content: In 2026–27, grades 1–12 start August 6 while preschool and kindergarten start August 10; the last day is May 27 for grades K–12 and May 26 for preschool.
Professional Release Days and Educator Workdays are no-school dates for students, but they are different staff-planning categories in the official key.
Parent Conference Exchange Days are no-school dates for students and should be checked separately from major vacation windows.
APS publishes the 2026–27 conventional calendar in English and Spanish and identifies monthly heritage observances; those observances add context but do not automatically change the class schedule.

districtFaqs.q: When does Aurora Public Schools start in 2026?
districtFaqs.a: The 2026–27 APS conventional calendar starts grades 1–12 on August 6, 2026. Preschool and kindergarten start August 10, 2026.

districtFaqs.q: Does Aurora Public Schools have different preschool and K–12 dates?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. APS marks separate first and last days: preschool and kindergarten start August 10 and preschool ends May 26, while grades 1–12 start August 6 and grades K–12 end May 27.

districtFaqs.q: What are APS Parent Conference Exchange Days?
districtFaqs.a: They are no-school dates for students identified separately from professional release and educator workdays. The 2026–27 conventional calendar lists October 30, 2026 and May 3, 2027.

districtFaqs.q: Is the Aurora Public Schools calendar available in Spanish?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The district’s 2026–27 conventional calendar resource includes English and Spanish versions.

districtFaqs.q: Where can families verify APS calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official APS District & School Calendars page and current district calendar resource for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Aurora Public Schools.
